findings.description: AWS access-key material is embedded in the Lambda environment variables and therefore in Terraform configuration/state; Lambda configuration readers can retrieve it. These long-lived credentials should be removed, rotated if real, and replaced with the execution role and a secrets-management service.
The function uses the deprecated nodejs12.x runtime, which no longer receives security patches and leaves the workload exposed to known runtime vulnerabilities.
